interface.fit: Model settings and Parameters for the current fit mode. Each visible field has a physical symbol, unit, help control and fit lock.
interface.guide: Parameters by fit mode. Show the model-defined eligibility matrix only here. User holds belong to Fit and do not change the reference matrix.
interface.navigation: Switching between Fit and Guide preserves all settings, entered values, bounds and holds.

identifiability.scope: Proposed strings.ts keys and core diagnostic IDs for the new composition contract.

parameters_caution.text: Seebeck data alone can leave several band parameters undetermined. Use independent measurements or hold parameters you know.

issues.text: With these band edges, every E_F inside the gap gives the same curves.
Several values of a free parameter reproduce the data equally well within the tested range.
This band has very few carriers across the fitted temperature range. Check how strongly its parameters affect the measured curves.
Electron and hole Hall contributions cancel within the resolution of these measurements. The Hall signal gives little information about the absolute mass scale here.

scope: proposed UI labels and fit eligibility; internal model identifiers and numerical results unchanged
numbering: i is the stable band row number (1–3); all offsets, mass ratios and relative transport weights reference Band 1; c/v follows CB/VB without renumbering

mass_reporting.parameters: Show the derived Band 1 value alongside its single-valley field when N_1 differs from one. It has no separate bounds or lock.
mass_reporting.earlier_runs: Preserve the saved DOS mass, units and valley count. Label the single-valley conversion as derived. Missing source metadata leaves the conversion unavailable.

fields.tooltip_en: Fermi energy at 0 K, referenced to the edge of Band 1. One value for the whole sample. The chemical potential at finite temperature is μ(T).

display_by_configuration.two_bands_one_CB_one_VB: Show E_g for E_c−E_v >= 0, and the explicit E_c−E_v for negative values. The editable coordinate is always E_c−E_v. If Band 1 is CB, negate the stored offset and swap and negate bound endpoints for display. Reuse the same hold and parameter ID.
display_by_configuration.three_bands_mixed: Edit both signed offsets relative to Band 1. Always show a Band gap · E_g summary at the top of Parameters. Display min(E_c)−max(E_v) when nonnegative, including zero. On overlap display Closed and the positive overlap magnitude. Identify every CB minimum and VB maximum involved, including ties. An incomplete offset shows a dash. The derived summary has no fit lock.
display_by_configuration.all_CB_or_all_VB: Edit offsets between edges of the same type. With three bands show Undetermined in the gap summary and identify the missing band type. A single band has no edge offset or gap field.

fields.tooltip_en: Edge of Band {i} minus the edge of Band 1; use c for each CB edge and v for each VB edge independently. Positive means higher on the electron energy axis.

Positive single-valley DOS mass at the Band 1 edge, in free-electron masses. A P17 DOS mass converts as m_b,1 = m_1(P17) / N_1^(2/3), using the saved valley count. Decode a raw legacy E coefficient by its original convention first.
Ratio of positive single-valley band-edge masses. Valley counts are entered separately.
Kane nonparabolicity of this band. Zero gives the parabolic limit.

Desktop acoustic scale label τ_ph,1 (legacy A). This is the normalized conductivity coefficient multiplying F₀, with units S/m, not a raw relaxation time in seconds. In all-parabolic models with multiple bands, S + ρ displays τ_ph,1/m_b,1; Hall displays τ_ph,1. These labels refer to the same stored normalized coefficient.
fields.definition: acPh: sigma_1=A*F0; acPhDis: A is the acoustic-limit scale

fields.tooltip_en: Desktop disorder scale label τ_dis,1 (legacy F). This normalized coefficient multiplies T in kelvin and F₀; its units are S/(m·K), not seconds. In all-parabolic models with multiple bands, S + ρ displays τ_dis,1/m_b,1; Hall displays τ_dis,1. These labels refer to the same stored normalized coefficient.

Relative transport weight referenced to Band 1: x = ph for acPh and acPh + dis (legacy B), x = dis for pure dis (legacy G). The full conductivity ratio also depends on masses, valley counts and filling; this is not the ratio of measured band conductivities.

Elastic modulus divided by squared acoustic deformation potential for the Kane band in the Lin–Liu model. Only acPh is offered when a Kane band is present. Absolute normalization remains a proposed extension requiring verification.
Number of equivalent valleys in this band. Spin is counted separately.
Lowest temperature included in the fit.
Highest temperature included in the fit.

Acoustic conductivity scale for this parabolic band in a composition containing Kane. Only acPh is offered. No extra relative-weight field describes the same band pair. Absolute normalization remains a proposed extension requiring verification.

fields.legacy_or_tdd: C (Band 1); D (Band 2); no desktop letter for Band 3
fields.tooltip_en: Acoustic-to-disorder relaxation-time ratio at 300 K for Band {i}. Legacy C for Band 1 and D for Band 2. The corresponding crossover temperature is 300 K times this ratio. Pure dis uses its own scale and relative weight.
Conductivity scale of Band 1 for the web ionized-impurity power-law model (legacy A). Multiplies (T/300 K)³ F₂; this is a conductivity coefficient, not a relaxation time.
Relative ionized-impurity transport weight for Band {i} referenced to Band 1 (legacy B). Conductivity ratios also depend on masses, valley counts and filling.

alternate_coordinates.tooltip_en: Band conductivity divided by its Fermi integral at 300 K.
alternate_coordinates.role: alternate coordinate for documentation/export; not an editable form field

alternate_coordinates.legacy_or_tdd: f_i (§14); derived from C or D
alternate_coordinates.label_en: Acoustic scattering fraction at 300 K · Band {i}
alternate_coordinates.tooltip_en: Acoustic rate divided by the total scattering rate at 300 K. Zero is pure alloy disorder and one is pure acoustic scattering.
alternate_coordinates.role: alternate coordinate for documentation/export; not an editable form field

label_rules.visible_fields: Use physics symbols. Legacy desktop letters A–G belong in tooltips only, never visible labels. Internal legacy identifiers remain available as metadata.
label_rules.fermi_reference: Visible label E_F; the 0 K and Band 1 edge reference belong in its tooltip.
label_rules.desktop_scale: For x = ph or dis, SPB uses τ_x,1. Multiple all-parabolic bands use τ_x,1/m_b,1 in S+rho and τ_x,1 in S+rho+R_H. Labels do not change the normalized stored coefficient or its units.
label_rules.scale_warning: The desktop τ labels denote normalized transport coefficients, not raw seconds. Do not infer a new mass conversion from a label change.
label_rules.kane: At most one Kane band; its presence forces acPh for the whole composition. Each band has its own absolute prefactor; no duplicate relative field.

states.fit: Visible and eligible to fit unless held by the researcher.
states.manual: Visible and editable; excluded from fitting by this mode.
states.hidden: Not shown and not fitted in this mode.

all_parabolic.mixed_mechanism_S: For multiple bands, manually entered relative weights and per-band 300 K mechanism ratios affect S. For one parabolic band these rows remain hidden.

model_settings.valleys: Manual positive integers; not fit variables.
model_settings.temp_low: Manual fit-range setting; not a fit variable.
model_settings.temp_high: Manual fit-range setting; not a fit variable.

researcher_holds.scope: One persisted hold per parameter identity and applicable model/scattering context, shared across fit modes; do not key a hold by mode.
researcher_holds.effect: A held parameter remains editable but is excluded from fitting wherever it is eligible.
researcher_holds.mode_switch: Preserve values and holds across mode switches, including hidden/manual states; restore the hold when returning to a fit-eligible state.
researcher_holds.mode_forced_manual: Mode-forced manual state is independent of researcher holds: the value stays editable and cannot be enabled for fitting in that mode. Do not overwrite a saved hold when entering a manual state.
researcher_holds.context: Keep independent values/holds for different band-type compositions and mechanism-specific scales/relative weights; do not silently transfer an acoustic or disorder scale to ionized impurities.

alternate_coordinate_policy.applies_to: all-parabolic acPhDis only; relative exists only for bands i > 1
alternate_coordinate_policy.P_i: P_i is the effective conductivity prefactor at 300 K, not the editable acoustic-limit scale. It includes the mixed-mechanism reduction and the band mass/valley weight.
alternate_coordinate_policy.f_i: f_i is the acoustic fraction of the total scattering rate at 300 K; it is an alternate coordinate to the editable relaxation-time ratio r_i = τ_ph,i/τ_dis,i.
alternate_coordinate_policy.mapping: For positive rates at T0 = 300 K, f_i = 1/(1+r_i). P_i = acoustic_limit_prefactor_i/(1+r_i). Pure-mechanism endpoints are limits; do not divide by a zero Fermi integral when deriving coordinates.
alternate_coordinate_policy.storage: Do not fit P_i/f_i alongside the corresponding editable scales/ratios; they describe the same degrees of freedom.
